discription: A warm pulse wave pad with subtle pulse width modulation and a low-pass filter for a smooth, evolving texture.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, detune=0.001, pwRate=0.2, pwDepth=0.1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000; var sig, env, lfo, lpf; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.5, 0.7, 1.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); lfo = LFCub.ar(pwRate, 0, pwDepth) + 0.5; sig = Pulse.ar(freq * (1 + (detune * LFNoise1.ar(8))), lfo, 0.5); lpf = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff * env.linlin(0, 1, 0.5, 1.5), rq); Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(lpf * amp * env, pan)); }
